hero.title: Italian Language Classes for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Studying Language Courses in Italy allows Indian students to learn a new language, enhance their communication skills, prepare for university admission, and experience Italian culture. Italy offers Italian language learning opportunities to beginners, intermediate, advanced and international students who want to improve their knowledge of the Italian language for study, work or personal reasons.

highlights.eligibility: Recognised academic qualification + English / Italian proficiency

overview: Studying Language Courses in Italy allows Indian students to learn a new language, enhance their communication skills, prepare for university admission, and experience Italian culture. Italy offers Italian language learning opportunities to beginners, intermediate, advanced and international students who want to improve their knowledge of the Italian language for study, work or personal reasons.

Students have the opportunity to take Italian language courses in Italy , intensive language programs, university language courses, summer language schools, and specialized courses in business or academic Italian. Some institutions also offer courses in other languages depending on their programs and partnerships with language schools.
The right course will depend on your current level, how much time you have to study, your budget and whether you are learning Italian for daily communication, higher education or career development.

sections.title: Why take language courses in Italy?

items: Learn by immersion: Use Italian in everyday situations, in shops, on transport, in cafés and socially;
Improve communication skills: Develop speaking, listening, reading and writing skills.
Get ready for college: Gain Italian-language proficiency for university programs taught in Italian.
Italian Culture: Discover the local traditions, history, food, and regional variety.
Learn career skills: Italian language skills can help with jobs in tourism, hospitality, business, translation and customer service.
Explore flexible learning options: Some institutions offer courses in intensive, standard, evening or summer formats.
Language exams preparation: Some schools also prepare students to take recognized Italian language proficiency exams.
The language courses vary in intensity and length. Basic communication skills may be the focus of a short course, but a longer program can help students progress to an advanced level of proficiency.

For example, the University for Foreigners of Perugia offers Italian language and culture courses in presence with minimum duration of four weeks.

sections.title: Language Course Entry Requirements in Italy

items: The Italian language course admission requirements could include:
A valid passport.
Application or registration form completed.
If asked, latest photo.
Results of placement test.
Previous language certificates, if any.
Certificate of enrollment at a university for restricted courses.
Pay the fee for registration or course.
Other documents required by the Institution.

If you are traveling to Italy specifically to study the Italian language, then you should check the visa rules that apply to you depending on your nationality, the length of the course and your circumstances. Admission to a language course does not guaranty a visa.
6. Prices for Italian Language Courses

The cost of Italian language courses in Italy varies depending on the institution, number of lessons, course intensity, and duration. Private language schools, university language centers and specialist programs may charge different fees.

These are example planning estimates not verified prices for the institutions listed above. Fees may be lower or higher, depending on lesson hours, format of course and provider.
Additional costs could include accommodation, food, transport, textbooks, insurance, travel and visa costs. Budget these on separate line items.
Scholarships & Aid
Short language courses may have limited scholarships, unlike programs leading to a full degree. Depending on the provider and eligibility, students can explore:
School-specific financial aid.
Savings for longer enrollments.
Scholarships linked to wider study programs
Funding opportunities provided by institutions or cultural organizations.
Do not assume a language course is eligible for a scholarship or tuition waiver. Read the terms and deadlines that apply.
7. Italy: Procedure to Join the Language Course
Choose your language goal: Choose between everyday Italian, Italian for academic purposes, business communication or exam preparation.
Select a course provider: Compare universities, language schools, dates of courses, location and mode of delivery.
Find out your level: Maybe take a placement test or sign up for a beginner course if none of this sounds familiar.
The requirements must be verified. Kindly confirm the age limits, eligibility, required documents, course fees and cancelation policy.
Send in your application: Complete the official registration and submit the required documents.
Secure your place: Pay the appropriate fee and receive written confirmation of your enrollment.
Organize travel formalities: Check the visa requirements, accommodation, insurance and travel arrangements before you leave.
Start your course: Attend classes, do practice activities and participate in language and cultural experiences.
Each institution has different start dates and application deadlines. Some short courses are available throughout the year, while others are on fixed monthly or semester schedules.
8. Language Course Certificates & Acknowledgments
After a language course in Italy , students can receive a certificate of attendance, a certificate of completion or a record of their language level, depending on the institution.
Before you enroll, check that:
Whether a certificate is given.
Whether the certificate signifies attendance, completion, or demonstrated proficiency.
Whether there is an examination.
Whether your certificate will be accepted by your desired university or for your professional purpose.

For formal proof of Italian language proficiency , please check the requirements of the receiving institution or authority. Depending on the purpose and organization requesting proof, some of the recognized certification options are CILS, CELI and PLIDA .
A short language course certificate is not always the same as a recognized language proficiency test.
9. Career and Education Opportunities After Learning a Language in Italy
Italian can complement a degree, improve everyday communication and improve professional development. But a language course alone does not ensure employment or professional qualification.
Italian language skills may be useful in the following potential opportunities:
Tourism and hospitality.
Provide support to customer service and international.
The skills and qualifications are translated and adjusted as needed.
Help with international business and sales.
International education and cultural exchange.
Further studies at universities in Italy.
Roles requiring communication with Italian speaking customers.
Employment opportunities are based upon language fluency, education, experience, work authorization and the needs of the employer.

unis.name: Who can attend a language course in Italy?
unis.desc: Eligibility for language courses in Italy depends on the institution, course level and planned duration of study. Short Italian courses: A valid passport for overseas travel. Basic information about the application and the documents you need to register. Previous knowledge of Italian is not required for beginner courses. If the institution requires it, a placement test. Minimum age requirements if relevant. For intermediate and advanced courses: Previous knowledge of Italian or the result of a suitable placement test. If requested, evidence of previous study. Adequate proficiency for academic or specialized courses. For university-connected language courses: Some courses are restricted to students enrolled in a degree program or participating in an exchange program. Other institutions welcome self-directed language learners. Always check course specific requirements prior to applying.

faq.question: Are Italian courses in Italy open to Indian students?
faq.answer: Yes, Indian students can explore Italian language programs in Italy offered by universities and language schools, subject to meeting the provider's eligibility criteria and applicable travel regulations.

faq.question: How long are Italian language courses in Italy?
faq.answer: Duration is from a few weeks to several months or a semester. For example, the Perugia University for Foreigners has in-person courses lasting at least four weeks.

faq.question: Do I have to speak Italian before starting a language course?
faq.answer: No. We have beginner courses for students with no previous knowledge. Some intermediate and advanced courses may require a placement test or previous language experience.

faq.question: What is the cost to study Italian in Italy?
faq.answer: The cost will vary depending on the provider, number of lessons and length. Please refer to the current official fee schedule and also account for accommodation, travel and other expenses separately.

faq.question: Can I work in Italy after completing an Italian language course?
faq.answer: Taking a language course may help to improve your communication skills but does not guaranty you employment or work authorization. Employment opportunities depend on your qualification, experience, proficiency and applicable immigration rules.
